In November 2024 I gave a talk at PyCon Ireland on quasi-experimental design and causal inference using CausalPy. The slides can be found [here](https://nathanielf.github.io/talks/pycon_ireland_causalpy/pycon_2024.html#/title-slide).

The recording of the talk is available on YouTube.
